hook.convey: one whole folded in half, one half coloured → folded again → more, smaller pieces coloured → has the coloured amount changed or not is the question

use.hi: Socho, ek roti ko beech se moda aur ek aadhe hisse par ghee lagaya. Ab usi roti ko ek baar aur moda, toh ghee wale tukde do ho gaye.
use.en: Picture a roti folded down the middle, with ghee spread on one half. Now the same roti is folded once more, and the ghee part is now two pieces.

use.hi: Ek drawing sheet ko aadha moda aur ek aadhe hisse mein colour kiya. Phir sheet ko dobara moda, toh colour wale khaane do ho gaye.
use.en: A drawing sheet is folded in half and one half is coloured. Then the sheet is folded again, and the coloured part is now two boxes.

explain.convey: one roti folded once → 2 equal parts; 1 coloured = 1/2 → predict: fold again, how many equal parts in all

point.hi: Yeh roti beech se modi gayi hai, toh iske 2 barabar hisse hain. Ek hissa rang wala hai, woh 1/2 hai, yaani aadhi roti.
point.en: This roti is folded down the middle, so it has 2 equal parts. One part is shaded; that is 1/2, half the roti.

prompt.hi: Isi roti ko ek baar aur beech se modo. Ab poori roti mein kul kitne barabar hisse honge?
prompt.en: Fold this same roti down the middle once more. How many equal parts will the whole roti have now?

why.hi: beech se modne par 2 hisson mein se har ek 2 mein bant jaata hai, aur 2 × 2 = 4
why.en: folding down the middle splits each of the 2 parts into 2, and 2 × 2 = 4

simpler.hi: Roti ko beech se moda, toh 2 barabar hisse bane. Rang wala ek hissa aadhi roti hai, isliye woh 1/2 hai.
simpler.en: Folding the roti down the middle makes 2 equal parts. The one shaded part is half the roti, so it is 1/2.

explain.convey: same roti folded again → 4 equal parts; the coloured half is now 2 smaller parts → 2/4; no colour added or taken away → 2/4 = 1/2 → transfer: two more folds make 16 equal parts, count the shaded ones

point.hi: Ab wahi roti 4 barabar hisson mein hai. Rang wala aadha 2 chhote hisson mein bant gaya, toh rang wala hissa 2/4 hai. Rang na joda, na hataya, isliye 1/2 = 2/4.
point.en: Now the same roti is in 4 equal parts. The shaded half has split into 2 smaller parts, so the shaded part is 2/4. No colour was added or taken away, so 1/2 = 2/4.

prompt.hi: Isi roti ko do baar aur beech se modo, toh poori roti ke 16 barabar hisse ho jayenge. Inmein se kitne hisse rang wale honge?
prompt.en: Fold this same roti down the middle two more times, and the whole roti will have 16 equal parts. How many of them will be shaded?

why.hi: do aur mod se rang wale 2 hisse 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 ho jaate hain, jo 16 ka aadha hai
why.en: two more folds turn the 2 shaded parts into 2 × 2 × 2 = 8, which is half of 16

simpler.hi: Roti dobara modi, toh har hissa do chhote hisson mein bant gaya. Rang wala aadha ab 4 mein se 2 hisse hai, isliye 1/2 aur 2/4 utna hi rang hai.
simpler.en: Folding again splits every part into two smaller parts. The shaded half is now 2 of 4 parts, so 1/2 and 2/4 are the same amount of colour.

explain.convey: 0-to-1 line in eighths: the half-way point carries three names, 1/2, 2/4 and 4/8 → one point, one amount, many names → transfer: where three quarters sits in eighths

point.hi: Yeh sankhya rekha 0 se 1 tak 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Beech wala nishaan 1/2 bhi hai, 2/4 bhi aur 4/8 bhi. Toh 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8: ek hi jagah, ek hi maatra, teen naam.
point.en: This number line from 0 to 1 is split into 8 equal parts. The middle mark is 1/2, and also 2/4, and also 4/8. So 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8: one place, one amount, three names.

prompt.hi: Isi rekha par 0 se 3/4 tak jaana hai. Iske liye 1/8 wale kitne hisse lagenge?
prompt.en: On this same line, you go from 0 to 3/4. How many 1/8 parts does that take?

why.hi: 3/4 ke upar aur neeche dono ko 2 se guna karo toh 6/8 banta hai
why.en: multiplying the top and bottom of 3/4 by 2 gives 6/8

simpler.hi: Rekha ka beech wala nishaan ek hi jagah hai. Usko 1/2 bolo, 2/4 bolo ya 4/8, maatra wahi rehti hai.
simpler.en: The middle mark of the line is one single place. Call it 1/2, 2/4 or 4/8, the amount stays the same.

problem.hi: Sana ek chaukor rumal ko aadha modti hai aur ek aadhe hisse mein rang bharti hai. Phir rumal ko do baar aur aadha modti hai. Kholne par kitne barabar hisse honge, aur rang wala hissa kaunsa bhinn hai?
problem.en: Sana folds a square hanky in half and colours one half. Then she folds it in half two more times. When it is opened, how many equal parts are there, and what fraction is coloured?

givens.hi: pehla mod: aadha, ek aadha rang wala
givens.en: fold 1: in half, one half coloured

givens.hi: do mod aur, har baar aadha
givens.en: two more folds, each in half

find.hi: kholne par kul barabar hisse aur rang wala bhinn
find.en: the number of equal parts and the fraction coloured when opened

do.hi: Pehle mod ke baad hisse dekho
do.en: Look at the parts after the first fold

why.hi: ek mod se rumal do barabar hisson mein banta hai
why.en: one fold makes the hanky into two equal parts

simpler.hi: Ek baar aadha modne se rumal ke 2 barabar hisse bante hain. Unmein se ek rang wala hai, toh woh 1/2 hai.
simpler.en: One fold in half makes 2 equal parts of the hanky. One of them is coloured, so that is 1/2.

do.hi: Doosre mod ke baad hisse dekho
do.en: Look at the parts after the second fold

why.hi: har hissa do chhote hisson mein banta hai, toh kul hisse bhi dugne aur rang wale bhi dugne
why.en: every part splits into two smaller parts, so the total parts double and the coloured parts double too

simpler.hi: Doosre mod se har hissa do mein bant gaya, toh 4 hisse bane. Rang wala hissa bhi do bana, toh 2/4 rang wala hai.
simpler.en: The second fold splits every part in two, so there are 4 parts. The coloured part also becomes two, so 2/4 is coloured.

prompt.hi: Teesra mod bhi har hissa do chhote hisson mein baant deta hai. Ab rumal ke kul kitne barabar hisse honge?
prompt.en: The third fold also splits every part into two smaller parts. How many equal parts will the hanky have in all now?

simpler.hi: Abhi 4 barabar hisse hain, aur har mod hisson ko dugna karta hai. Bas 4 ka dugna socho.
simpler.en: There are 4 equal parts now, and every fold doubles the parts. Just think of double 4.

answer.hi: rumal ke 8 barabar hisse hain aur 4 rang wale, yaani 4/8, jo 1/2 aur 2/4 ke barabar hai
answer.en: the hanky has 8 equal parts with 4 coloured, that is 4/8, which equals 1/2 and 2/4

why.hi: har mod par kul hisse aur rang wale hisse dono dugne hote hain, par rang wali jagah utni hi rehti hai
why.en: at every fold the total parts and the coloured parts both double, but the coloured area stays the same

prompt.hi: Do ek jaisi chocolate bar hain. Mohit ne ek bar ka 1/2 khaya. Anjali ne doosri bar ke 6 barabar tukdon mein se 3 tukde khaaye. Zyada kisne khaya: Mohit ne, Anjali ne, ya dono ne barabar?
prompt.en: Two identical chocolate bars. Mohit ate 1/2 of one bar. Anjali ate 3 of the 6 equal pieces of the other bar. Who ate more: Mohit, Anjali, or did they eat the same?

why.hi: 6 barabar tukdon mein se 3 tukde 3/6 hain, aur 3/6 = 1/2
why.en: 3 of 6 equal pieces is 3/6, and 3/6 = 1/2

simpler.hi: 6 barabar tukdon mein se 3 tukde matlab aadhe tukde. Ab isko Mohit ke 1/2 se milaao.
simpler.en: 3 of 6 equal pieces means half of the pieces. Now match that with Mohit's 1/2.

prompt.hi: Yeh sankhya rekha 0 se 1 tak 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. 0 ke baad chautha nishaan ringed hai. Woh nishaan 1/2 se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?
prompt.en: This number line from 0 to 1 is split into 8 equal parts. The 4th mark after 0 is circled. Is that mark bigger than 1/2, smaller, or equal?

why.hi: 0 ke baad chautha nishaan 4/8 hai, aur 4/8 = 1/2
why.en: the 4th mark after 0 is 4/8, and 4/8 = 1/2

simpler.hi: Rekha ke 8 barabar hisse hain, aur 1/2 theek beech mein hota hai. Dekho chautha nishaan beech mein hai ya nahi.
simpler.en: The line has 8 equal parts, and 1/2 sits right in the middle. See whether the 4th mark is in the middle.

say.en: This bar has 8 equal parts with 4 shaded, that is 4/8. The shading reaches exactly half the bar, so 4/8 = 1/2: there are more pieces, but each piece is smaller.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaise pizza: Farhan ne ek ka 1/3 khaya, {friend} ne doosre ke 6 barabar slice mein se 2. Zyada kisne, ya barabar?
prompt.en: Two same pizzas: Farhan ate 1/3 of one, {friend} ate 2 of 6 equal slices of the other. Who ate more, or the same?

why.hi: 6 barabar slice mein se 2 slice 2/6 hain, aur 2/6 = 1/3
why.en: 2 of 6 equal slices is 2/6, and 2/6 = 1/3

simpler.hi: Pizza ke 6 slice ke teen barabar dher banao, toh har dher mein 2 slice aate hain. Farhan ka 1/3 ek dher jitna hai.
simpler.en: Make three equal heaps of the 6 slices, and each heap has 2 slices. Farhan's 1/3 is as much as one heap.

bridgeToNext.hi: Modne par 1/2 se 2/4 bana: kul hisse 2 se 4, rang wale 1 se 2, dono dugne hue, aur maatra wahi rahi. Ab bina mode, sirf guna karke barabar bhinn banayenge.
bridgeToNext.en: Folding turned 1/2 into 2/4: total parts 2 to 4, coloured parts 1 to 2, both doubled, and the amount stayed the same. Next we make equivalent fractions without folding, just by multiplying.

hook.convey: a whole in 5 equal parts, 2 coloured → every part split into 2 → both the part count and the coloured count change together → multiply top and bottom by the same number

use.hi: Ek drawing sheet par 5 barabar khaane hain, unmein se 2 mein colour bhara hai. Ab har khaane ke beech ek seedhi line kheencho.
use.en: A drawing sheet has 5 equal boxes, and 2 of them are coloured. Now draw a straight line down the middle of every box.

use.hi: Ek cake ke 3 barabar tukde hain aur ek tukda tumhara hai. Mummy har tukde ko do chhote barabar tukdon mein baant deti hain.
use.en: A cake has 3 equal pieces and one piece is yours. Mummy splits every piece into two smaller equal pieces.

explain.convey: bar in 5 equal parts, 2 shaded = 2/5 → predict: split every part into 2, how many parts in all

point.hi: Is patti ke 5 barabar hisse hain aur 2 rang wale, yaani 2/5. Neeche wala 5 batata hai ki patti kitne hisson mein bati hai, upar wala 2 ki kitne rang wale hain.
point.en: This bar has 5 equal parts with 2 shaded, that is 2/5. The bottom number 5 tells how many parts the bar has, the top number 2 how many are shaded.

prompt.hi: Is patti ka har hissa 2 chhote barabar hisson mein baanto. Ab poori patti mein kul kitne hisse honge?
prompt.en: Split every part of this bar into 2 smaller equal parts. How many parts will the whole bar have now?

why.hi: 5 hisson mein se har ek 2 ban gaya, aur 5 × 2 = 10
why.en: each of the 5 parts became 2, and 5 × 2 = 10

simpler.hi: Patti 5 barabar hisson mein bati hai, unmein 2 rang wale hain. Neeche ka 5 kul hisse batata hai, upar ka 2 rang wale.
simpler.en: The bar is split into 5 equal parts, and 2 are shaded. The bottom 5 tells all the parts, the top 2 tells the shaded ones.

explain.convey: same bar, every part split in 2 → 10 parts, 4 shaded = 4/10; shading unchanged → 2/5 = 4/10; top 2 × 2, bottom 5 × 2 → both by the same number → transfer: split every part into 3 instead

point.hi: Ab wahi patti 10 barabar hisson mein hai aur 4 rang wale, yaani 4/10. Rang utna hi hai, toh 2/5 = 4/10. Upar 2 × 2 = 4 aur neeche 5 × 2 = 10: upar aur neeche dono × 2.
point.en: Now the same bar is in 10 equal parts with 4 shaded, that is 4/10. The shading is the same, so 2/5 = 4/10. Top 2 × 2 = 4 and bottom 5 × 2 = 10: top and bottom both × 2.

prompt.hi: Isi 2/5 wali patti ka har hissa 2 ki jagah 3 chhote hisson mein baanto. Ab rang wale chhote hisse kitne honge?
prompt.en: Split every part of this same 2/5 bar into 3 smaller parts instead of 2. How many small shaded parts will there be now?

why.hi: 2 rang wale hisson mein se har ek 3 ban gaya, aur 2 × 3 = 6
why.en: each of the 2 shaded parts became 3, and 2 × 3 = 6

simpler.hi: Patti ke hisse chhote kiye, par rang utna hi raha. Isliye 2/5 aur 4/10 ek hi maatra hain, upar aur neeche dono 2 se guna hue.
simpler.en: The parts got smaller, but the shading stayed the same. So 2/5 and 4/10 are one amount, with top and bottom both multiplied by 2.

explain.convey: adding the same number to top and bottom is not the same move: 1/2 and 2/3 sit at two different points of a 0-to-1 line in sixths → not equal → transfer: 1/3 with 1 added to both gives 2/4 = 1/2, compared with 1/3 by place on the same line

point.hi: Kuch bachche 1/2 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodkar 2/3 likhte hain. Sankhya rekha dekho: 1/2 aur 2/3 alag jagah par hain, toh woh barabar nahi.
point.en: Some children add 1 to the top and bottom of 1/2 and write 2/3. Look at the number line: 1/2 and 2/3 are in different places, so they are not equal.

prompt.hi: Isi rekha par 1/3, 0 ke baad doosre nishaan par hai. 1/3 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodo toh 2/4 banta hai, jo 1/2 ke barabar hai. 2/4, 1/3 se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?
prompt.en: On this same line, 1/3 is at the 2nd mark after 0. Add 1 to the top and bottom of 1/3 and you get 2/4, which equals 1/2. Is 2/4 bigger than 1/3, smaller, or equal?

why.hi: 2/4 = 1/2 hai, aur isi rekha par 1/2 ka nishaan 1/3 se aage hai
why.en: 2/4 = 1/2, and on this line the 1/2 mark comes after 1/3

simpler.hi: Upar aur neeche 1 jodne se bhinn barabar nahi rehta. Rekha par 1/2 aur 2/3 alag jagah hain, toh unki maatra alag hai.
simpler.en: Adding 1 to the top and bottom does not keep a fraction equal. On the line 1/2 and 2/3 sit in different places, so their amounts differ.

problem.hi: 3/5 ke barabar aisa bhinn dhoondo jiska neeche wala number 10 ho.
problem.en: Find a fraction equal to 3/5 with 10 as its bottom number.

givens.hi: naye bhinn ka neeche wala number: 10
givens.en: bottom number of the new fraction: 10

find.hi: naye bhinn ka upar wala number
find.en: the top number of the new fraction

do.hi: Neeche dekho, 5 kis number se guna hokar 10 banta hai
do.en: Look at the bottom: 5 times what makes 10

why.hi: neeche ka number 5 se 10 karna hai
why.en: the bottom number has to go from 5 to 10

simpler.hi: Neeche abhi 5 hai aur 10 chahiye. 5 ko 2 se guna karo, toh 10 milta hai.
simpler.en: The bottom is 5 now and we need 10. Multiply 5 by 2 and you get 10.

steps.result: har paanchwa hissa 2 chhote hisson mein bantega, rang wale hisse bhi

why.hi: neeche ko 2 se guna karna matlab har hissa do mein baantna, aur rang wale hisse bhi usi tarah bant-te hain
why.en: multiplying the bottom by 2 means splitting every part in two, and the shaded parts split the same way

simpler.hi: Patti ka har hissa 2 chhote hisson mein baanto. Rang wale hisse bhi usi tarah do-do ban jaate hain.
simpler.en: Split every part of the bar into 2 smaller parts. The shaded parts also split into two each in the same way.

prompt.hi: Upar ke 3 ko bhi 2 se guna karo. Neeche 10 ho, toh 3/5 ke barabar bhinn ka upar wala number kya hoga?
prompt.en: Multiply the top 3 by 2 as well. With 10 at the bottom, what is the top number of the fraction equal to 3/5?

simpler.hi: Neeche wala number 2 se guna hua, toh upar wala bhi 2 se guna hoga. Bas 3 ka dugna socho.
simpler.en: The bottom number was multiplied by 2, so the top is multiplied by 2 too. Just think of double 3.

answer.hi: upar wala number 6 hai, toh 3/5 ke barabar bhinn 6/10 hai
answer.en: the top number is 6, so the fraction equal to 3/5 is 6/10

why.hi: upar aur neeche dono ko ek hi number 2 se guna kiya, toh har hissa do mein bata aur rang utna hi raha
why.en: the top and bottom were both multiplied by the same number 2, so every part was split in two and the shading stayed the same

prompt.hi: 2/7 ke barabar ek naya bhinn banana hai jiska neeche 14 ho. Is naye bhinn ka upar kya aayega?
prompt.en: Make a new fraction equal to 2/7 with 14 at the bottom. What goes at the top of this new fraction?

why.hi: neeche 7 × 2 = 14 hua, toh upar bhi 2 × 2 = 4
why.en: the bottom went 7 × 2 = 14, so the top is 2 × 2 = 4

simpler.hi: Pehle dekho 2/7 ka neeche wala number kis number se guna hokar 14 banta hai. Upar wale ko bhi usi number se guna karo.
simpler.en: First see what number the bottom of 2/7 is multiplied by to make 14. Multiply the top by that same number.

prompt.hi: {friend} ne 3/4 ke upar aur neeche dono mein 1 jodkar 4/5 likha, aur kaha ki dono barabar hain. Kya yeh sahi hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: {friend} added 1 to both the top and bottom of 3/4, wrote 4/5, and said they are equal. Is that right, yes or no?

why.hi: 1 jodna ek hi number se guna nahi hai, aur 3/4 = 15/20 jabki 4/5 = 16/20
why.en: adding 1 is not multiplying by one number, and 3/4 = 15/20 while 4/5 = 16/20

simpler.hi: Barabar bhinn banane ke liye upar aur neeche dono ko ek hi number se guna karte hain. 1 jodna guna karna nahi hai.
simpler.en: To make an equal fraction, we multiply the top and bottom by one same number. Adding 1 is not multiplying.

prompt.hi: 4/5 ke barabar ek naya bhinn banana hai jiska upar 12 ho. Is naye bhinn ka neeche kya aayega?
prompt.en: Make a new fraction equal to 4/5 with 12 at the top. What goes at the bottom of this new fraction?

why.hi: upar 4 × 3 = 12 hua, toh neeche bhi 5 × 3 = 15
why.en: the top went 4 × 3 = 12, so the bottom is 5 × 3 = 15

simpler.hi: Dekho 4/5 ka upar wala number kis number se guna hokar 12 bana. Neeche wale ko bhi usi number se guna karo.
simpler.en: See what number the top of 4/5 is multiplied by to make 12. Multiply the bottom by that same number.

say.hi: Pehle is patti ka 1/4 rang wala tha. Har hissa 2 mein baanta, toh ab 8 barabar hisse aur 2 rang wale, yaani 2/8: upar 1 se 2, neeche 4 se 8, dono badle.
say.en: At first 1/4 of this bar was shaded. Every part was split in 2, so now 8 equal parts with 2 shaded, that is 2/8: top 1 to 2, bottom 4 to 8, both changed.

prompt.hi: 2/3 ke barabar bhinn ka neeche 9 hai. Uska upar kya aayega?
prompt.en: A fraction equal to 2/3 has 9 at the bottom. What goes at its top?

why.hi: neeche 3 × 3 = 9 hua, toh upar bhi 2 × 3 = 6
why.en: the bottom went 3 × 3 = 9, so the top is 2 × 3 = 6

simpler.hi: Dekho 2/3 ka neeche wala number kis number se guna hokar 9 banta hai. Upar wale ko bhi usi number se guna karo.
simpler.en: See what number the bottom of 2/3 is multiplied by to make 9. Multiply the top by that same number.

remediation.move: 0-to-1 line in sixths: 1/2 at 3 sixths, 2/3 at 4 sixths → adding 1 to top and bottom moved the point → adding is not an equivalence move; multiply both by one number

say.hi: Rekha par 1/2 aur 2/3 alag nishaan hain, toh upar aur neeche mein 1 jodne se maatra badal gayi. Barabar bhinn ke liye dono ko ek hi number se guna karo.
say.en: On the line, 1/2 and 2/3 are different marks, so adding 1 to the top and bottom changed the amount. For an equal fraction, multiply both by the same number.

prompt.hi: 1/4 ke barabar ek bhinn ka upar 2 hai. Uska neeche kya aayega?
prompt.en: A fraction equal to 1/4 has 2 at the top. What goes at its bottom?

why.hi: upar 1 × 2 = 2 hua, toh neeche bhi 4 × 2 = 8
why.en: the top went 1 × 2 = 2, so the bottom is 4 × 2 = 8

simpler.hi: Dekho 1/4 ka upar wala number kis number se guna hokar 2 bana. Neeche wale ko bhi usi number se guna karo.
simpler.en: See what number the top of 1/4 is multiplied by to make 2. Multiply the bottom by that same number.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab barabar bhinn banana aa gaya, jaise 2/5 = 4/10. Ab ulta kaam: do bhinn diye hon, jaise 2/3 aur 6/9, toh kaise check karein ki woh barabar hain ya nahi.
bridgeToNext.en: Now we can make equivalent fractions, like 2/5 = 4/10. Next, the reverse: given two fractions, like 2/3 and 6/9, how to check whether they are equal.

hook.convey: two same-size wholes, one in 4 equal parts with 3 filled, the other in 8 with 6 filled → different numbers, same amount → how to check without a picture is the question

use.hi: Ek video game mein do health bar ek jaise lambe hain. Ek 4 barabar khaanon mein bata hai aur 3 bhare hain, doosra 8 khaanon mein aur 6 bhare hain.
use.en: In a video game, two health bars are the same length. One is split into 4 equal blocks with 3 filled, the other into 8 blocks with 6 filled.

use.hi: Do ek jaise cake hain. Ek ke 4 barabar tukdon mein se 3 tumhare hain, doosre ke 8 barabar tukdon mein se 6 tumhare bhai ke.
use.en: Two identical cakes. 3 of the 4 equal pieces of one are yours, and 6 of the 8 equal pieces of the other are your brother's.

explain.convey: 0-to-1 line in eighths: 6 eighths from 0 reach the mark that is also 3/4 → 3/4 and 6/8 land on the same point → transfer: 1/4 and 2/8 on the same line

point.hi: Yeh sankhya rekha 0 se 1 tak 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. 0 se 6 chhote hisse chalo toh 6/8 aata hai, aur wahi nishaan 3/4 bhi hai. 3/4 aur 6/8 ek hi nishaan par hain, toh 3/4 = 6/8.
point.en: This number line from 0 to 1 is split into 8 equal parts. Walk 6 small parts from 0 and you reach 6/8, and that mark is also 3/4. 3/4 and 6/8 are at the same mark, so 3/4 = 6/8.

prompt.hi: {friend} ka kehna hai ki 1/4 aur 2/8 barabar nahi ho sakte, kyunki unke number alag hain. Isi rekha ko dekhkar batao, kya yeh sahi hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: {friend} says 1/4 and 2/8 cannot be equal because their numbers are different. Looking at this same line, is that right, yes or no?

why.hi: is rekha par 2/8 aur 1/4 ek hi nishaan par hain, 0 ke baad doosra nishaan
why.en: on this line 2/8 and 1/4 sit at the same mark, the 2nd mark after 0

simpler.hi: Rekha par 0 se 6 chhote hisse chalo, toh 6/8 aata hai. Wahi nishaan 3/4 bhi hai, toh dono ek hi maatra hain.
